1.explanation: We create a minimal test.js containing the exact JSX and U+3000 characters from the bug report. Then run Prettier programmatically in a loop using the same parser option as the CLI (`--parser babel`). On each iteration you will observe two different outputs: one with an extra normal space before the IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE and one without, reproducing the unstable formatting behaviour.
1.bug_scenario: When you format a small JSX snippet that contains IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE characters (U+3000) around an expression, Prettier 1.19.1 produces two different outputs on alternating runs. In one run it leaves the IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE immediately after the closing tag, and on the next run it inserts an extra normal space before the IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE. This makes the formatted file flip-flop on every save or lint invocation.
